name: Fortify Health: iron fortification through a mental-health lens (Ambitious Impact, 2020 mental health report)
summary: Ambitious Impact's 2020 estimate of Fortify Health's wheat flour fortification in India, made for its mental health research: iron lowers anaemia, and with it the risk of depression, anxiety and other psychiatric and developmental conditions, plus anaemia's own disability and a small gain in earnings. Fortify Health was AIM's first incubated charity (2017); this is AIM's own model of its program, beside GiveWell's. A re-implementation of AIM's sheet. Its bottom line, $546 per QALY, subtracts the good the charity's money and staff would have done elsewhere; before that subtraction it is $91 per QALY, the figure used when credit is shared by resources. The report's headline of $50 per QALY counts only the program's intervention costs (premix, equipment, mill operations), not staff or administration.

rows.explainer: Changed for consistency. Ambitious Impact values the income gain in dollars (the gain times income per person, $2,010) at $25,000 per QALY: 0.000101 QALYs. Our view values it like every other income gain on the site: the gain in log consumption times the shared value of income, in healthy years at the shared rate between a healthy year and a doubled-income year (Your values). The evaluator view uses Ambitious Impact's number. Pinned there: $25,000 per QALY over income of $2,010 is 12.4 years of income per QALY, with income counted at its dollar value (1 per unit of log consumption for small gains).

QALYs the money and staff would have produced elsewhere
rows.explainer: Ambitious Impact subtracts the QALYs the charity's money would have produced at other charities (75% at $100 per QALY, 25% at $500) and its founders' and staff's would have produced elsewhere: 7,465 of the 8,969 QALYs a year, which turns $91 per QALY into $546. This is Ambitious Impact's counterfactual credit, kept as published. With credit by share of resources (Your values) the outcome is instead shared out by every contributor's money and staff's forgone pay, so this subtraction is off (0). The sheet labels this SWLS; it is QALYs.
